protocol.title: A Droplet-Based Screen for Wavelength-Dependent Lipid Production in Algae
protocol.platform: Digital microfluidics (DMF) on open electrode array with custom LED illumination system
protocol.organism: Cyclotella cryptica (CCMP 332) — diatom model for biofuel lipid research
protocol.objective: High-throughput multiplexed screening of algal culture illumination conditions for neutral lipid production, with minimal manual intervention; discovery of wavelength-dependent lipid accumulation and mechanistic ROS investigation

dispensing.notes: Narrow central electrodes on all dispenser modules facilitate necking during droplet formation; ratio >= 0.5:1 required for reliable parallel dispensing on bussed electrodes

device.waste_management: Vertical through-holes (1 mm dia.) in waste reservoir electrodes; spent fluid wicks away from device onto absorbent tissue below
device.automation: Impedance sensing and feedback control over droplet position; automated actuation sequence management

algae_suspension.culture_medium: f/2 medium (NCMA) supplemented with biotin and cyanocobalamin (2 nM each) and 0.02% w/v Pluronic F68
algae_suspension.culture_vessel: Pyrex media bottles, max vol. 200 mL
algae_suspension.light_cycle: 12 h white light / 12 h dark alternating

lipidTOX.product: HCS LipidTOX Green neutral lipid stain (Life Technologies, Burlington, ON, Canada)
lipidTOX.function: Fluorogenic reporter; fluoresces in presence of neutral lipids (triacylglycerols, TAG)

dcfda.product: DCFDA cellular reactive oxygen species detection assay kit (ab113851, Abcam, Cambridge, MA)
dcfda.function: Fluorescent reporter for intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS)

ascorbic_acid.function: Antioxidant; scavenges ROS to test photooxidative stress mechanism

fc_medium.composition: f/2 medium supplemented with biotin, cyanocobalamin, 0.02% w/v Pluronic F68
fc_medium.notes: Standard complete culture medium used for all algae maintenance and on-chip culture

fc_medium_no_silicon.function: Positive control for ROS induction (silicon deprivation known to induce ROS in C. cryptica)

illumination_system.optimal_condition: 15h blue (~450 nm) / 9h yellow (~580 nm) at 250 umol/m2/s
illumination_system.optimal_result: ~4-fold increase in neutral lipid production vs. control; ~2-fold vs. yellow or blue alone

steps.name: Algae culture maintenance and device sterilisation
steps.sterilisation: DMF devices incubated in 70% ethanol for 10 min prior to use
steps.algae_prep: Weekly subculture at 1:10 ratio; density confirmed by absorbance at 660 nm in 200 uL aliquots in clear-bottom 96-well plates using plate reader
steps.notes: Algae maintained in exponential growth phase; cell strainer not required for DMF loading (Pluronic F68 in media prevents aggregation)

steps.name: Device loading — active reservoir initialisation
steps.reservoir_circulation: Continuous circular mixing on four active electrodes to maintain homogeneous cell density until use
steps.notes: Only two manual pipette steps required to initiate a full 24 h run generating 48 measurements (24 absorbance + 24 fluorescence). Active reservoir abstracted as mix loop in BioScript.

steps.name: Culture droplet dispensing (Step 2 of screening sequence)
steps.dispensing: Bussed electrodes; all 8 dispensed in single actuation sequence
steps.notes: Representative single droplet lineage encoded in BioScript; hardware parallelism handles 8 simultaneous culture droplets

steps.name: Dye label droplet dispensing (Step 3 of screening sequence)
steps.notes: Source droplet dispensed from LipidTOX active reservoir; 8 label droplets formed via bussed dye dispensing electrodes. Second source droplet dispensed if volume insufficient for 8 labels.

steps.name: Absorbance measurement — daughter culture droplet (Step 4 of screening sequence)
steps.notes: Device placed on transparent 384-well plate for absorbance measurement at each time point

steps.name: Fluorescence measurement — staining and detection (Step 5 of screening sequence)
steps.merge: 8 daughter culture droplets (2 uL each) merged with 8 label droplets (2 uL each)
steps.waste: Mixed droplets driven to waste reservoirs after measurement; fluid wicks through 1 mm through-holes onto tissue below device
steps.notes: Device placed on black 384-well plate for fluorescence measurement. Steps 3-5 repeated after each illumination incubation phase.

steps.name: Multicolour illumination screen (Protocol 1)
steps.measurement_schedule: Steps S5-S6 repeated at t=0, 6, 24 h (Steps 3-5 of screening sequence repeated 2x after incubation)
steps.device_incubation_schedule: 6 h under LED array → repeat Steps 3-5 → 18 h under LED array → repeat Steps 3-5
steps.key_finding: Yellow LEDs (~580 nm) produce highest neutral lipid accumulation per cell (>2x vs. control) at high intensity; blue LEDs (~450 nm) produce highest biomass growth

optimal_condition.result: ~4-fold lipid increase vs. control; ~2-fold vs. yellow or blue alone
optimal_condition.mechanism: Blue phase allows rapid proliferation (high growth); yellow phase drives lipid accumulation (photooxidative stress)

macroscale_validation.result: Trends identical to microscale; confirms microfluidic hits scale to macro-culture

steps.name: ROS mechanistic assay (Protocol 3)
steps.purpose: Test whether yellow illumination elevates reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, linking wavelength-dependent lipid accumulation to photooxidative stress

conditions.label: Yellow 24h + ascorbate
conditions.expected: reduced ROS vs. arm A (antioxidant rescue)

conditions.label: Silicon deprivation (off-chip positive control)
conditions.expected: high ROS (known inducer in C. cryptica)
conditions.notes: Macroscale 200 mL flask control; not encoded in DMF BioScript

dcfda_protocol.resuspension: 50 mL complete media, complete media without silicate, or complete media + 50 ug/mL ascorbate

steps.result: Yellow light and silicon deprivation produce significantly higher ROS than blue or normal conditions; ascorbate reverses yellow-light ROS elevation, confirming photooxidative stress mechanism

lipid_body_morphology.microscope: Leica DM2000 (Leica Microsystems Inc., Concord, ON, Canada)

throughput.measurements_breakdown: 24 absorbance + 24 fluorescence (8 conditions x 3 time points)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Device loading, active reservoir init, multicolour screen (P1), blue/yellow screen (P2), ROS assay (P3)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose colour screen QC signals; begin blue/yellow screen

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose blue/yellow QC signals; begin ROS mechanistic assay

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_8_t
basic_blocks.action: dispose all three ROS arm droplets

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_9_f
basic_blocks.action: drain all three ROS arm droplets

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_10_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose all ROS QC signals; NOP; experiment ends
